# Extract the away team scores for matches where Melbourne is the away team
melbourne_away = df[df['away team'] == 'melbourne'].copy()

# Parse the away team score column to extract the numeric score (the part before the space)
melbourne_away['away_score_numeric'] = melbourne_away['away team score'].str.split().str[0].astype(float)

# Get all away team scores across the dataframe
all_away_scores = df['away team score'].str.split().str[0].astype(float)

# Find the unique away scores and sort them
unique_away_scores = all_away_scores.unique()
sorted_unique_scores = sorted(unique_away_scores)

# Determine the second lowest unique away score
if len(sorted_unique_scores) >= 2:
    second_lowest_score = sorted_unique_scores[1]
else:
    second_lowest_score = None

# Check if Melbourne's away score(s) include the second lowest unique away score
if second_lowest_score is not None:
    # Check if any of Melbourne's away scores equals the second lowest unique away score
    melbourne_has_second_lowest = (melbourne_away['away_score_numeric'] == second_lowest_score).any()
else:
    melbourne_has_second_lowest = False

answer = bool(melbourne_has_second_lowest)
